name: narrated vertical video from a comparison
query: Turn this into a 20-second vertical video with narration: the difference between giving an agent a goal and letting it iterate, versus drawing the whole path in advance and letting it only walk that path.
expected_behavior: Checks whether HyperFrames is available BEFORE promising an MP4
If HyperFrames is absent: delivers the motion tier and states plainly that MP4 needs it — does not invent a rendering pipeline and does not silently downgrade
Splits the script into short lines, synthesises each separately, and derives every frame timing from MEASURED durations — never from a characters-per-second estimate
Sets act-ending gaps from how long the picture still needs to perform, not from punctuation
Uses a different transition on each adjacent seam, and leaves no blank gap at a seam
Varies the headline entrance per scene while keeping one uniform exit
Spaces sound cues against measured file durations and puts transition sounds on their own track
Verifies the rendered MP4 with ffprobe and inspects frames pulled from the rendered file, not the preview
Every number stated on screen is read off the real artefact
